scripts.check: corepack pnpm check:docs && corepack pnpm check:format && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test:tooling
scripts.build: corepack pnpm -r run build && node scripts/check-miniapp-build.mjs
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm -r run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.tooling.json
scripts.test: corepack pnpm -r run test && corepack pnpm test:integration
scripts.check:format: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .prettierrc.json tsconfig*.json *.mjs playwright.config.ts scripts apps/*/src apps/*/test apps/*/config apps/admin/e2e apps/*/*.json apps/*/*.ts apps/*/*.cjs apps/admin/index.html .github/workflows/*.yml --ignore-unknown
